# Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha (Pm Bi)

**ID:** Pm Bi  
**Section:** Pātimokkha (pm)  
**Collection:** Vinaya  
**Title (Pali):** Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha

## AI-generated Overview (from reference literature)

*This overview was drafted by an AI model from the cited scholarship and catalog data and may contain errors; verify against the sources before relying on it.*

A dedicated classical commentary on the code is found in Buddhaghosa's *Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī* [Nakamura 1980].

Text-reuse and parallel analyses demonstrate extensive shared material across Buddhist Vinaya traditions. Modern English translations of the Theravāda text include that by Bhikkhu Brahmali.

**Sources**

- [Blackstone 1995] Kathryn R. Blackstone, Standing Outside the Gates: A Study of Women's Ordination in the Pali Vinaya (1995) — Count of 311 rules for the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha
- [Hüsken 1997] Ute Hüsken, Die Vorschriften für die buddhistische Nonnengemeinde im Vinaya-Piṭaka der Theravādin (1997) — Status of the confession formula embedded in the Bhikkhunīvibhaṅga
- [Lamotte 1988] Étienne Lamotte, History of Indian Buddhism: From the Origins to the Śaka Era (1988) — Seven categories of offenses in the Bhikkhunī Pātimokkha
- [Nakamura 1980] Hajime Nakamura, Indian Buddhism: A Survey with Bibliographical Notes (1980) — Commentary on the Pātimokkha in the Kaṅkhāvitaraṇī
